annotation.title_clean: GPT versus Humans: Uncovering Ethical Concerns in Conversational Generative AI-empowered Multi-Robot Systems
annotation.title_en: GPT versus Humans: Uncovering Ethical Concerns in Conversational Generative AI-empowered Multi-Robot Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Rousi, R.; Mäkitalo, N.; Samani, H.; Kemell, K.; Siqueira de Cerqueira, J.; Vakkuri, V.; et al.
annotation.summary_en: Qualitative study comparing ethical concerns about LLM-empowered multi-robot systems raised by human experts (two workshops, N=16) and GPT agents (one workshop). Humans stressed deviance, privacy, bias and corporate conduct; GPT echoed existing AI ethics guidelines. Proposes the MORUL framework for ethical development of multi-robot systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Human experts raised novel concerns: deviance, data privacy, bias, unethical corporate conduct.
GPT agents mainly reproduced concerns found in existing AI ethics guidelines.
Human oversight is key to keeping multi-robot systems ethical.
Programmed obsolescence flagged as a sustainability and corporate responsibility issue.
Advances the MORUL framework for ethical multi-robot system development.
